description: This file defines a template class 'LockableContainerType' that extends a container with thread-safe read/write locking capabilities using a ReadWriteLock. It provides methods for acquiring and releasing read and write locks, and manages lock state internally.

classes.name: LockableContainerType
classes.description: A thread-safe container wrapper that adds read/write locking to an underlying container.

methods.name: operator=
methods.description: Assignment operator that locks the container for writing, copies the contents, then unlocks.

methods.name: ReadLock
methods.description: Acquires a read lock with an optional wait time.

methods.name: WriteLock
methods.description: Acquires a write lock with an optional wait time.
